description: This PHP source file defines the AssignClaimController class within the OrangeHRM Claim plugin. The class extends an abstract Vue controller and manages the assignment of claims, including providing currency data and authentication info to a Vue component for rendering purposes.

classes.name: AssignClaimController
classes.description: Controller responsible for handling claim assignment views, providing necessary data such as currencies and authenticated employee number to the front-end Vue component.

methods.name: getPayGradeService
methods.description: Retrieves an instance of PayGradeService from the service container, used for obtaining currency data.

methods.name: preRender
